summary: This directory contains unit tests focused on validating the generation of markdown content for various sections of a README file. It ensures that data structures are correctly transformed into human-readable messages describing project architecture, dependencies, and development setups.
responsibilities: Verify the correct generation of text-based documentation messages.
Validate the transformation of project metadata into README content.
Ensure documentation section consistency for different project aspects.
relationships: Documentation generators transform raw project metadata into structured README content.
Test suites validate that the output messages meet expected documentation standards for each specific project area.
designDecisions: Co-location of validation logic with the generation modules under test.
Granular test decomposition based on specific README sections.
